title: What needs attention before your next release?
description: Explore where your product changed, inspect the context behind those changes, and revisit the decisions that still need attention. LangDrift connects the release overview with the records and review conditions behind it, so leadership can move from a question to a specific next decision.

onboarding.label: Onboarding
onboarding.description: Help a new workspace owner reach a useful first result with clear guidance and minimal manual setup.

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.description: Make connecting the first data source understandable and predictable, including recovery from connection problems.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.description: Help a workspace owner choose appropriate access without requiring prior knowledge of the permission model.

E01.title: Workspace defaults
E01.summary: The setup starts with documented defaults so a new owner can try the core workflow before adjusting advanced settings.

E02.title: Manual integration setup
E02.summary: A temporary manual configuration step was accepted to make the first integration available sooner.

E03.title: Contextual setup guidance
E03.summary: The team explored explanations beside setup choices after interviews surfaced uncertainty about their meaning.

E04.title: Advanced configuration gate
E04.summary: A gate appeared before the first useful result, outside the ordering recorded in the onboarding scope.

E05.title: Early invitation step
E05.summary: An invitation step appeared before the first result, although the scoped sequence placed it afterward.

E06.title: Alternate setup path
E06.summary: An alternate setup path appears in the release inventory, but its supporting sources have not been linked yet.

E07.title: Connection retry summary
E07.summary: The connection flow now explains which retry action is available after a failed attempt.

E08.title: Clearer connection errors
E08.summary: Connection messages identify what the owner can check before trying again.

E09.title: Connection scope preview
E09.summary: The owner can inspect the proposed connection scope before confirming the setup.

E10.title: Fallback scope mismatch
E10.summary: A fallback path exposed a different scope from the one described in the connection specification.

E11.title: Guided permission presets
E11.summary: The permission step explains the intended audience of each preset before the owner chooses one.

E12.title: Role selection proposal
E12.summary: A role-selection proposal appears in the release inventory without linked specification or decision context.

sources.E01-S: The first-use flow starts with default settings. Advanced configuration comes after the owner reaches an initial result.
sources.E01-D: Keep the default path available for first-time owners. Advanced configuration remains an optional later step.
sources.E01-V: The reviewed flow reaches the first result without requiring advanced configuration. This verifies the documented step order, not a conversion improvement.
sources.E01-F: In the example session, an owner reached the initial result and then asked where to adjust the defaults. One session does not establish the outcome for all users.
sources.E02-S: The target setup connects the first data source without manually copying configuration values.
sources.E02-D: Accept manual configuration for the initial integration release to make it available sooner. Revisit this compromise before broader rollout using setup observations and support feedback.
sources.E02-V: The reviewed integration works with the documented manual configuration step. The review does not establish how much difficulty that step creates for new owners.
sources.E03-S: Explore short explanations beside setup choices while preserving a compact onboarding flow.
sources.E03-D: Run a small prototype exercise to investigate whether contextual explanations address the uncertainty found in interviews. Do not treat the exercise as a production outcome.
sources.E03-F: Participants in the example prototype exercise described their next setup choice more clearly after reading its explanation. Broader validation remains outside this observation.
sources.E04-S: Advanced configuration follows the first useful result in the scoped onboarding sequence.
sources.E04-V: The inspected flow requires advanced configuration before the first result. The review records this ordering difference as unexpected relative to the scoped sequence.
sources.E04-F: An owner in the example session stopped at the configuration gate because the requested values were unfamiliar. The observation does not establish how often this happens.
sources.E05-S: Invite additional teammates after the owner has seen the first useful result.
sources.E05-V: The inspected flow places the invitation step before the first result. The review records that ordering difference as unexpected; it does not quantify its effect.
sources.E07-S: After a failed connection attempt, explain the retry action available to the owner.
sources.E07-D: Include a concise retry summary in the first connection flow so the owner can understand the next available action.
sources.E07-V: The reviewed failure path displays the retry summary and the available action. No claim about long-term recovery rates is made.
sources.E08-S: Connection errors should name a check the owner can perform before retrying.
sources.E08-D: Replace the generic connection failure message with a short explanation of the relevant configuration check.
sources.E08-V: The inspected error states include the documented check and retain the retry action.
sources.E08-F: In the example session, the owner used the message to identify which configuration value to check. This is a session observation, not a success-rate metric.
sources.E09-S: Show the proposed connection scope before the owner confirms setup.
sources.E09-D: Add the scope preview to the confirmation step while preserving the existing connection permissions.
sources.E09-V: The reviewed confirmation step displays the proposed scope before submission. The preview does not change permissions by itself.
sources.E10-S: The fallback path must preserve the connection scope confirmed by the owner.
sources.E10-V: The inspected fallback path displays a different scope from the confirmed one. The review records the mismatch as unexpected relative to the specification.
sources.E10-F: In the example session, the owner asked why the fallback scope differed from the confirmed selection. The record captures confusion without assigning a numerical impact.
sources.E11-S: Explain who each permission preset is intended for before requiring a selection.
sources.E11-D: Keep the permission presets and add audience descriptions to support the owner's choice.
sources.E11-V: The reviewed permission step shows an audience description beside each existing preset.
sources.E11-F: An owner in the example session used the audience description to explain the preset they selected. This does not establish policy suitability for every workspace.

R01.title: Review the manual setup compromise
R01.summary: The manual setup compromise needs setup observations and support feedback before broader rollout.
R01.nextDecision: Should the manual step remain for the broader audience, or should guided configuration be completed first?
R01.limit: No user feedback is linked to this event.

decision.label: Decision recorded
decision.description: Manual configuration was accepted for the initial integration release.

reviewed.label: Flow reviewed
reviewed.description: The delivered setup includes the accepted manual step.

pending.label: Before broader rollout
pending.description: Gather setup observations and support feedback, then review whether the additional effort remains acceptable.

R02.title: Review the configuration gate
R02.summary: The configuration gate needs a decision about its scope before this flow is expanded.
R02.nextDecision: Should the gate apply to a narrower evaluation path, or should the broader onboarding target be deliberately revised?
R02.limit: No decision accepting this ordering change is linked.

scope.label: Scope recorded
scope.description: Advanced configuration follows the first useful result.

observed.label: Difference observed
observed.description: The inspected flow requires configuration earlier.

pending.label: Before expanding this flow
pending.description: Decide whether to restore the scoped sequence or explicitly revise the target and rationale.

R03.title: Establish the context of the alternate path
R03.summary: The alternate path needs its intended flow and rationale established before classification.
R03.nextDecision: What target and decision should this alternate path be evaluated against?

inventory.label: Inventory entry
inventory.description: An alternate setup path was listed in the release inventory.

pending.label: Before classifying the change
pending.description: Link the intended flow and the rationale for introducing this path.

R04.title: Establish the role proposal's scope
R04.summary: The role proposal needs its intended audience and permission policy documented before a rollout decision.
R04.nextDecision: Which audience and permission requirements should guide this proposal?
R04.limit: No supporting sources are linked. The review request itself is not evidence of an approved policy.

inventory.label: Inventory entry
inventory.description: A role-selection proposal was listed without supporting context.

pending.label: Before deciding on rollout
pending.description: Document the intended audience and permission policy, then review the proposal against that scope.
